standard_prerequisites: the local subcategory of D_QCoh supported on a closed subset and its perfect generator
internal Hom in D_QCoh, its quasi-coherence and compatibility with restriction to opens
colimit representations using the generator and compactness of O_X
the factor-through lemma for maps into the thick subcategory generated by E
perfectness of the cone over a map to a perfect object supported on T
core_obligations: Prove that a morphism alpha : P to E in D_QCoh with P perfect or pseudo-coherent and E supported on a closed T with quasi-compact complement admits a perfect I with I to O_X killing the composite I tensor P to E while restricting to the identity over U
proof_roadmap: In both cases the internal Hom K = RSheafHom(P,E) is a supported object of D_QCoh, and alpha corresponds to a map O_X[0] to K, reducing the problem to that case
Write K as the homotopy colimit of the K_n constructed from the supported generator E; the countable-sum commutation and compactness of O_X realize alpha at a finite stage as alpha_n : O_X to K_n
The factor-through lemma factors alpha_n through some Q in the thick closure of E, a perfect complex supported on T
The cone I of the map O_X[0] to Q is perfect, restricts to an isomorphism over U since Q vanishes there, and I to O_X composed with alpha is zero
difficulty_reason: H2: a generator-colimit argument with compactness and thick-closure factorization; each step is quoted and the final triangle assembles the claims.
